checks.label: Issue body contains all required sections (context, scope, preconditions, GWT, test cases, invariants, kill criteria, CI gate)
At least 3 test cases (positive, boundary, negative)
At least 1 property-based invariant defined (not trivial: reject len(x)>=0, x is not None, true==true)
NOT-accepted section contains ≥1 concrete degenerate with Input/Expected that tests must reject (no filler like 'solutions that don't work')
CI/CD gate defined with runnable commands
Code level justified (zero code > lean code > tools > LLM pipeline)
Red Team test passed — no gaming strategy found
